title: Hierarchical Token Bucket & Sliding Window Rate Limiter
prompt:
Fix the timing, boundary, and multi-tier atomicity bugs in this rate limiter package (`limiter`).

Reported issues:
1. Rate limiters ignore injected clocks (`VirtualClock` / monotonic clock) in refill/timestamp checks, making behavior depend on wall-clock `time.time()`.
2. Sliding window expiration fails at exact window boundaries (`now - window_seconds`), causing an immediate retry after the returned `retry_after` delay to still be rejected.
3. Requests with `cost > capacity` (or `cost < 0`) misbehave instead of raising `CostExceedsCapacityError` (or `ValueError`).
4. Hierarchical rate limiting (`HierarchicalLimiter`) deducts tokens/quota from earlier tiers (such as per-tenant) even when a later tier (such as global quota) rejects the request — leaking quota permanently across rejected requests.

Inspect the package and run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_public.py"`.
